{"decision": "The team discussed the research findings for LFP and Solid-State home battery technologies. We agreed on the following key comparison metrics for the upcoming final report:
1. Energy Density & Form Factor (comparing volumetric and gravimetric efficiency)
2. Safety & Thermal Stability (comparing risk of thermal runaway and electrolyte volatility)
3. Cost & Commercial Maturity (comparing current $/kWh economics vs. developmental/early-commercial pricing)
4. Cycle Life & Durability (comparing expected degradation over thousands of cycles)
5. Environmental Impact & Supply Chain (comparing raw material sourcing and recyclability)

Addressing Alice's and Eve's points: We note that solid-state technology is currently in early commercialization/pilot phases for stationary storage compared to the fully mature LFP market, and our metrics will directly contrast this maturity gap.", "title": "team_discussion_summary.md"}
